title: Capstone: the personal ledger
prompt: Finish the `Ledger` class. `net(datePrefix)` = sum of amounts with sign by direction, counting only transactions whose date starts with the prefix (use `""` for all). `labelsSince(datePrefix)` = labels of matching transactions, in insertion order, uppercase. `saveLines()` = every transaction rendered as `date|label|DIRECTION|amount` with exactly two decimal places, insertion order. `loadLine(line)` = parse one saved line and add it - but a malformed line must not corrupt the ledger: skip it silently if it fails the record's validation.

tests.name: net sums signed by direction and filters by date prefix
tests.hint: map sign by direction, filter by date.startsWith(prefix), sum into a double.

tests.name: labels are uppercase, insertion order
save renders two decimals in order
load round-trips, junk is skipped silently
tests.hint: try { add(parse-like code) } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) { /* skip */ } - never let one bad line crash the load.
